```gherkin
Feature: Self-Test
  As a user
  I want to run a self-test on the system
  So that I can verify its functionality

  Scenario: Test O2 Sensor Accuracy
    Given the O2 sensor is calibrated
    When the self-test is run
    Then the O2 sensor reading is accurate

  Scenario: Validate Blower Response
    Given the blower speed is set to 50%
    When the self-test is run
    Then the pressure achieved at that speed is within 10% of the commanded speed

  Scenario: Validate Pinch Valves Pressure Response
    Given the blower speed is set to 75%
    When the self-test is run
    Then the pinch valves pressure response is within 5% of the commanded pressure

  Scenario: Test Audible Alarm Devices
    Given the audible alarm devices are connected
    When the self-test is run
    Then all audible alarm devices work as expected

  Scenario: Test Visual Alarm Devices
    Given the visual alarm devices are connected
    When the self-test is run
    Then all visual alarm devices work as expected

  Scenario Outline: Test Audible Alarm Devices with Voltage
    Given the audible alarm devices are connected
    And the voltage is set to <voltage>
    When the self-test is run
    Then the current drawn by the audible alarm devices is greater than 0
    Examples:
      | voltage |
      | 12V     |
      | 24V     |
      | 0V      |

  Scenario Outline: Test Visual Alarm Devices with Voltage
    Given the visual alarm devices are connected
    And the voltage is set to <voltage>
    When the self-test is run
    Then the visual alarm devices are illuminated
    Examples:
      | voltage |
      | 12V     |
      | 24V     |
      | 0V      |

  Scenario Outline: Test Audible Alarm Devices with User Confirmation
    Given the audible alarm devices are connected
    And the user is present
    When the self-test is run
    Then the user confirms that the audible alarm devices are audible
    Examples:
      | user_confirmation |
      | yes               |
      | no                |

  Scenario Outline: Test Visual Alarm Devices with User Confirmation
    Given the visual alarm devices are connected
    And the user is present
    When the self-test is run
    Then the user confirms that the visual alarm devices are illuminated
    Examples:
      | user_confirmation |
      | yes               |
      | no                |
```
